title: ONVAL Flip after acceptance below
summary: Price initially broke below the ONVAL and started building acceptance below the level, as indicated by the increasing volume in the developing profile.
notes: Price initially broke below the ONVAL and started building acceptance below the level, as indicated by the increasing volume in the developing profile.
This was a key indication that the market was accepting lower prices, suggesting that participants were comfortable transacting within this discounted region.

With that in mind, when price eventually pulled back to retest the ONVAL from below, I saw it as a high-probability short opportunity, as the acceptance established below value supported the likelihood of a bearish continuation.

title: ONVAL Snap
summary: This is a classic Snap 🫰 setup. Nothing much to explain here, price came down and tapped the level and shot up!
notes: This is a classic Snap 🫰 setup. Nothing much to explain here, price came down and tapped the level and shot up!

title: P-shape ONVAL Flip
summary: This is The Flip 🔄. This was a P-shaped profile so longs were the play here.
notes: This is The Flip 🔄. This was a P-shaped profile so longs were the play here.
Apart from that, price broke through the level previously from below and now it was retesting the level from above.
Combined with the VWAP band, dVAL and HVN, this was a high probability long and it shot to TP instantly.

title: dPOC Magnet after dVAH acceptance
summary: Classic Magnet 🧲 setup. After price broke past the dVAH, I waited for some acceptance building beyond the dVAH (meaning participants are comfortable transacting at higher prices).
notes: Classic Magnet 🧲 setup. After price broke past the dVAH, I waited for some acceptance building beyond the dVAH (meaning participants are comfortable transacting at higher prices).
This was shown to me by the volume building beyond the dVAH in the developing volume profile. When price came back to the dPOC, it was a high probability continuation play back up.

title: D-shape dVAL Snap
summary: The developing profile was D-shaped, so the market was in balance and price kept rotating between the dVAH and the dVAL.
notes: The developing profile was D-shaped, so the market was in balance and price kept rotating between the dVAH and the dVAL.
Price dropped into the dVAL, couldn't hold below it and got bought straight back up. I went long at the dVAL with my stop just below it and my target at the dPOC, 1:1.
Hit target within minutes.
Lesson: in a D-shape, fade the edges until price breaks out.
